dmp.description: Improving urban quality of life is now increasingly at the top of the political agenda of modern cities. However, right policy treatment requires a thorough analysis and correct diagnosis. This project aims to create a modern and powerful urban quality of life analysis system which could be used as analytical base by lagging European cities to converge towards their peers. It provides a systematic assessment of the various quality of life dimensions – safety and trust, environment and infrastructure, urban governance, employment and poverty. Project is a quantitative research in Economics, with knowledge spillovers to Data Science, Sociology and Anthropology. It employs various hard and soft data sources, including Eurobarometer and Numbeo surveys. Scientific results will be disseminated via four original scientific articles, published Open Access and indexed in Web of Science and Scopus databases. Moreover, results will be presented in at least six public dissemination events, which are expected to deepen a cooperation with Riga City Council, other public institutions, business and NGOs. Extensive discussions with academic staff and incorporation of project into study process would foster capacity of a scientific team, further strengthened by international collaboration and knowledge sharing via membership in global academic societies. At the end of this project, a scientific team should be capable to design two new project applications, thus, enhancing the competitiveness of the University of Latvia in the long term.
